scripts.ios:prebuild: PATH="$PWD/src-tauri/ios/swift-shim:$PATH" cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --package ragcreator --target aarch64-apple-ios --features tauri/custom-protocol --lib --release
scripts.ios:build: rm -rf src-tauri/gen/apple/build && npm run ios:prebuild && tauri ios build --target aarch64 --export-method debugging
scripts.ios:prebuild:sim: PATH="$PWD/src-tauri/ios/swift-shim:$PATH" cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --package ragcreator --target aarch64-apple-ios-sim --features tauri/custom-protocol --lib --release
scripts.ios:sim: rm -rf src-tauri/gen/apple/build && npm run ios:prebuild:sim && tauri ios build --target aarch64-sim && xcrun simctl install booted src-tauri/gen/apple/build/arm64-sim/RAGCreator.app && xcrun simctl launch booted com.ragcreator.app
scripts.ios:sim:seed: C=$(xcrun simctl get_app_container booted com.ragcreator.app data) && mkdir -p "$C/Documents/medical_rag_project/projects" && cp medical_rag_project/rag_config.json "$C/Documents/medical_rag_project/" && cp -R medical_rag_project/projects/* "$C/Documents/medical_rag_project/projects/" && echo "data gekopieerd naar $C/Documents"
